text: ブラウン　せんせいに　えを　おしえて　もらってるの

structure.jp: ブラウン　せんせいに
えを　おしえて　もらってるの

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえて　もらってる
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form says you get someone to do something for you; the person who does it takes に. せんせいに　おしえて　もらってる = 'I'm having the teacher teach me'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on these days; てる is the casual short form. もらってる = 'am receiving'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence is the soft form of のだ, used a lot by girls and children, and gives the feeling of explaining. もらってるの = 'I'm having it done, you see'.
